799740.long_desc: Queen Ysilde of the cave elves sits before her silver mirror, a moth-embroidered shawl about her shoulders.
799740.description: A slender elf with skin the grey of pearl and long silver hair, her eyes pale from a life without the sun. She is the king's queen and his keenest spellcaster, and the guards say it is she, not he, who rules the kingdom.
